properties.name: Terra Borealis
properties.principle: Northern Eurasia east of the Urals to its continental margin: the West Siberian Basin, the Siberian craton, the Kazakh steppe, Verkhoyansk and Chukotka, Kamchatka and the Arctic shelf seas, ending at the craton's southern rim (ZR22), the Kazakh steppe's edge (ZR21) and the Sea of Okhotsk's median (ZR22).
